name: Custom Shape 4-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Shaker Desk Name Sign
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from a combination of high-quality wood and clear acrylic for durability and visual depth.
    - Features a 4-layer structure:
    Layer 1, 2 & 4: Wood, 5mm thickness.
    Layer 3 (middle layer): Acrylic, 5mm thickness, with  cut-out design to create an inner space that allows shaker charms to move freely.
    - Smoothly cut and polished edges ensure a clean, premium finish.
    - Includes acrylic name charms (minimum size 2cm, thickness 3mm) that move freely inside the shaker layer.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple sizes:
    6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
    8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
    - Custom-shaped with layered shaker construction.
    - Designed to stand securely on flat surfaces without additional support.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using high-quality UV printing technology for clear, vibrant, and long-lasting colors.
    - Features double-sided printing on selected layers for a polished and professional finish.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a shaker-style desk name sign with movable acrylic charms inside for a playful effect.
    - Perfect for display on desks, shelves, offices, bedrooms, or workspaces.
    - Adds a personalized and decorative touch to any space while remaining sturdy and stable.
    - Functions as both a custom name sign and a unique home or office décor piece.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful and personalized gift for moms, dads, couples, friends, and family members.
    - Perfect for Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, housewarmings, and special moments.
    - A fun and meaningful keepsake that combines craftsmanship with personalization.
  •

  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
